about: The refusals of the date and time operations: civil arithmetic, duration text, dtc and time_of_day (TIME-4, TIME-14, TIME-17, TIME-19, TIME-20, TIME-21), whose cases compare the fields their table compared, and date completion: impute's policy (TIME-10), the text impute, precision and to_date read (TIME-2, TIME-10, TIME-13) and their operands' types (TIME-1, TIME-2, TIME-7, TIME-8, TIME-18), and the text date_text reads in its declared forms and its source's type (TIME-22). They include study_day's operand types (TIME-1), every text that is no fixed-length ISO 8601 duration (TIME-17), shifts past the calendar and operand types a missing operand does not hide (TIME-4, TIME-14), a zero year with a month (TIME-13), month and day rules wider than any integer (TIME-10), and bounds and a fallback of another type than the declared one, which impute_bounds reaches after completing its source (TIME-1, TIME-9, TIME-13). dtc refuses each part outside its form, naming the part: a month or day of other than two digits or past its calendar, a year of other than four digits or zero, and an hour past 23, whether written as text or as a number (TIME-19); these come from temporal_date_text.rs at 144fc5559, whose table compared the phase, condition, rule, spec paths and part.

context.expected: datetime, ISO date text, or ISO 8601 datetime text
